forbidden.title: Admin token required
forbidden.body: This page needs a token with the admin role.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.revokeConfirmMessage: Anyone using this token loses access immediately.

newToken.warning: The token is shown only now. Anyone with the link can print.
newToken.roleAdminHelp: Full access: settings, tokens, all pages.
newToken.roleDruckenHelp: Can print and check status, no settings.
newToken.roleFamilieHelp: Family page only, limited copies per print.

lan.title: LAN sharing
lan.restartNeeded: Print service restart needed for the sharing to take effect (tapesmith daemon restart).
lan.hostnamesHint: One line per hostname, without port
lan.firewallHint: The Windows Firewall rule is created once by deploy\infra\setup-tapesmith-lan.ps1 as an administrator.

family.title: Family page
family.copyLimitHint: At most 5 copies per print are possible from a phone (misprint protection limit for outside access).
family.linkHint: The link to the family page is shown when a family token is created.
family.templatesHint: Only these templates appear on the family page.

mcp.title: MCP for Claude
mcp.httpHint: For MCP clients that connect over HTTP.
mcp.addressHint: Only reachable while Streamable HTTP is on.

hotfolder.title: Hot folder
hotfolder.enableHint: Files placed in the folder are printed.
hotfolder.dirHint: Leave empty for the default folder.
hotfolder.pollHint: How often the folder is checked (0.5 to 60 s).
hotfolder.settleHint: Waits until a file has been written completely.

mqtt.title: Home Assistant (MQTT)
mqtt.templatesHint: These templates can be printed over MQTT. Without a selection, all are allowed.
mqtt.enableHint: Reports the printer and templates to Home Assistant.
mqtt.hostHint: Host name or IP address of the broker.
mqtt.userHint: Leave empty to connect without login.
mqtt.passwordHint: Password of the broker. Stored in Windows Credential Manager.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.quietHoursNone: Off: notifications arrive around the clock.
telegram.enableHint: Sends notifications to a Telegram chat.
telegram.quietPeriodHint: Start and end, may span midnight.
telegram.offlineMinHint: How long the printer must be disconnected.
telegram.rollLowHint: Notice as soon as less tape is left.
telegram.notifyOfflineHint: The printer can no longer be reached.
telegram.notifyRollHint: The tape roll is running out.
telegram.tokenHint: Bot token from BotFather. Stored in Windows Credential Manager.
